articles.title: Security Guilloche
articles.summary: Fine interlaced guilloche arcs and beads; burnished crests give a crisp engraved security sheen. Reads as a fine beaded vertical grain or a rippled, speckled sheen; individual rings are lost and the columns give a faint vertical bias.
articles.what: Two independently placed engraving passes interlace fine figure-eight arclets, partial secondary arcs, recessed knots, beads and burnished crests. No isolated medallion l Up close: Vertical columns about 25 px apart made of stacked small rings, round dots and partial arcs, like a bead curtain, a bubble strand or engraved banknote lines. Rings are crisp and mid-contrast on both halves; slightly more visible, with clearer bright circles, on metal. Busy and fine, not a clean. From a distance: Reads as a fine beaded vertical grain or a rippled, speckled sheen; individual rings are lost and the columns give a faint vertical bias. No colour of its own. It changes the shine only, never the colour. Channels it touches: metal, roughness, clearcoat. Group: Engraved & Ornamental (Surface library tab of the spec overlay picker). Texture detail: micro.
when: Best on: hero panel, roof, trim.
how: Click a zone card and expand SPEC OVERLAYS.
Click + ADD SPEC OVERLAY, open the Surface library tab and the group "Engraved & Ornamental", or search for "Security Guilloche".
Click it, then click Add this overlay in the Inspect surface window.
Set Strength (default 50%) and tick the Metallic, Roughness and Clearcoat boxes you want.
Use Size and Rotation to make the texture finer, then render.
tips: Hood, roof and hero panels: ring columns show on flats
Avoid small trim: rings alias at distance
Numbers keep their colour; the busy rings add noise behind thin numerals, so use bold large numbers.
Fine ring-and-bead columns with medium contrast, visible in the highlight
Pairs well with: gloss, metallic, chrome.
pitfalls: Not a printed banknote graphic: no colour or fine line art
Not metal flake: round rings and dots in columns, not irregular flakes
Avoid: aliases badly at distance, needs large flat area.
articles.intent_note: A spec pattern changes the shine only: metal, roughness and clearcoat, never the paint colour.
articles.paint_advice: It cannot recolour anything. Metal added to a light paint looks bright; metal added to a dark paint stays dark, because metal reflection inherits the paint colour. Pair it with a paint that gives the gloss difference something to show on.

combos.why: Up to five overlays stack in order; a strong overlay can wash out the ones below it.
The blend mode decides how this overlay meets the base shine. Normal is the safe start.
Coat values 1 to 15 and roughness under 15 on non-chrome pixels are raised to safe values on export.

examples.title: Add it as an overlay
examples.goal: Layer Security Guilloche over a base finish.
examples.result: The shine of the zone gets this texture while the colours stay put.
